verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
verses.english: Ha. Mim.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.english: By the Scripture that maketh plain

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.english: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.english: Whereon every wise command is made clear

verses.arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.english: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.english: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

verses.arabic: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.english: Nay, but they play in doubt.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.english: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.english: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.english: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.english: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.english: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.english: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.english: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.english: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.english: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.english: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.english: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.english: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

verses.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.english: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.english: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.english: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.english: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.english: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.english: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.english: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.english: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.english: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.english: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.english: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.english: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.english: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.english: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.english: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.english: The food of the sinner!

verses.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.english: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

verses.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.english: As the seething of boiling water.

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.english: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.english: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.english: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.english: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.english: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.english: Amid gardens and watersprings,

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.english: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.english: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.english: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.english: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.english: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.english: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.english: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
